title: DEMO: pin — German AI-philosophy middle-ground gap
body:
Long-form payload fixture (hand-enriched — live DEMO data has body:null everywhere).

Observed gap: German-language AI-philosophy writing clusters at the poles (accelerationist hype vs. cultural pessimism). The pragmatic middle — working engineers reasoning carefully about what these systems are — is underserved.

Angle: position the records-as-credentials argument as the bridge.
